title: deterministic-gpu-nodepool-stencil-tfmodule-checkpoint
author: Aisha Kapoor
release_notes: Add new terraform module 'gpu-nodepool-stencil' which enables deterministic GPU nodepool creation, lease-backed ephemeral IAM roles, and network-anchored tfstate checkpointing. Backwards-compatible migration path and a small migrator script included.
description: Context & motivation: Private deployments require predictable nodepool identities and safer rollback semantics when operators apply changes across air-gapped or peered VPCs. Existing modules create GPU nodepools with provider-generated names and rely on global tfstate only; this makes cross-account reconciliation and on-prem rollback brittle. This PR introduces a new terraform module (modules/gpu-nodepool-stencil) that provides deterministic naming, optional lease-backed ephemeral IAM bindings, and a lightweight tfstate checkpointing mechanism anchored to network tags. Goals: 1) deterministic, stable nodepool identifiers to allow safe rebinds and tenant moves; 2) lease-based IAM sessions so nodepools get least-privilege, short-lived credentials for cluster bootstrap; 3) checkpointed state objects (S3/GCS) tied to VPC/subnet tags to support orchestrated rollbacks and faster drift detection. What changed: - New module: terraform/modules/gpu-nodepool-stencil/ implementing deterministic naming strategy, nodepool fencing IAM templates, and optional network-anchor checkpointing hook. - New outputs and inputs to make module pluggable into existing private-installer stacks (vpc_id, subnet_tags, tenant_id, naming_seed). - Add tfstate-checkpoint script (scripts/tfstate_checkpoint.sh) used as a post-apply hook to write a minimal JSON checkpoint object to configured object store with network tag metadata. - Add migrator: scripts/tfstate_migrator_detname.go to compute deterministic names and optionally migrate state entries for existing installs (dry-run mode by default). - Add e2e-local test harness under test/integration/gpu-nodepool-stencil/ that runs a plan/apply against a local GCS-compatible backend (minio) to validate checkpoint creation and IAM binding lifecycle. - Documentation: docs/private-deploy/gpu-nodepool-stencil.md with examples and migration steps. - CI: terraform fmt/lint, unit tests for naming math, and an integration smoke test. Backwards compatibility & migration: The migrator is intentionally opt-in. The module has a toggle 'adopt_existing_names' and 'migrator_mode' with 'dry-run' by default; operators must run the migrator and confirm checkpoints before flipping adoption flags. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented with full variable validation - [x] Post-apply checkpoint hook implemented and tested against minio - [x] Migrator included and documented - [x] Unit tests for naming algorithm - [x] Integration smoke test added - [x] Docs added and linked in private-installer README Testing & validation: Ran CI pipeline (format/lint/plan) — initially one formatting error, fixed in commit 3. Integration harness executed end-to-end on local minio and created checkpoint objects with expected metadata. Security & IAM: The module creates IAM role templates only; actual role assumption is gated by a 'lease' provider that issues ephemeral tokens (TTL configurable). The default behavior is conservative (no IAM creation unless 'enable_ephemeral_iam' is true). Migration notes: Run scripts/tfstate_migrator_detname.go --dry-run to preview changes, then create checkpoints for current state, then flip 'adopt_existing_names'. Related work: ENG-6342 (deterministic node ids), ENG-6401 (rollback checkpoints).
commits_summary: commit 1: scaffold gpu-nodepool-stencil module and variables; commit 2: add deterministic naming algorithm and unit tests; commit 3: add tfstate checkpoint hook and minio test fixtures; commit 4: add migrator tool and docs; commit 5: fix fmt, address lint failures and reviewer feedback; commit 6: add e2e smoke test and CI matrix updates.
review_comments: Liam Chen: Please ensure the naming seed is stable across upgrades; if we change seed format later we'll need a migration path.
Aisha Kapoor: The module exposes 'naming_seed' (string) and 'naming_version' (int). We added unit tests for versioned name derivation and included migrator to map old->new names.
Sofia Martinez: We need to avoid automatic IAM creation for orgs that manage roles centrally. Can you gate ephemeral role creation behind a flag?
Aisha Kapoor: Added 'enable_ephemeral_iam' defaulted to false and documented centralized-iam integration pattern.
Ethan Park: CI plan showed a terraform fmt failure and a flaky integration test on the first run.
Aisha Kapoor: Fixed fmt issue and increased integration test timeout; re-ran CI. All checks passed.
Sofia Martinez: Approved after confirming migrator is opt-in and docs include rollback steps.
Liam Chen: Approved. Recommend squash merge to keep history concise.
notes: This PR is intended to be low-risk by default. The default toggles avoid changing IAM or names unless operator opts in. The migrator and checkpoint objects provide a safe path for teams that want deterministic names for cross-account reconciliation.
egress_instructions: Operators: read docs/private-deploy/gpu-nodepool-stencil.md, run migrator with --dry-run, provision a checkpoint bucket and set backend config, then flip 'adopt_existing_names' only after validating checkpoints.
risk_assessment: Medium: introduces new state artifacts (checkpoint objects) and optional IAM templates. Risk is mitigated by opt-in flags, dry-run migrator, and unit/integration tests.
changelog_entry: Added GPU nodepool 'stencil' terraform module supporting deterministic naming, lease-backed ephemeral IAM templates, and tfstate checkpointing for safer rollback and rebind operations. Includes migrator and docs.
notes_for_release_team: Include note in private-installer release notes about the new module and emphasize the opt-in migration path. Recommend contacting platform engineering for org-wide IAM policies before enabling ephemeral IAM.
proof_of_concept_outputs: Sample checkpoint object created in minio under prefix 'checkpoints/vpc-12345/gpu-nodepool-stencil/2026-01-14T15:23:01Z.json' with metadata {"vpc_tag":"internal-prod","tenant":"tenant-42","module_version":"v1"} (redacted in repo).
